[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to cook quinoa perfectly, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Rinse quinoa to remove saponin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Use a 2:1 ratio of water to quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Soaking is optional.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cook on medium heat.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Don't overcook; it should take about 15-20 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Fluff with a fork after cooking.
